data.narrative: Student demonstrated thorough log literacy, forensic precision, and intellectual honesty throughout Module 02. For Bug #3, the student traced the missing request lifecycle logs to hardcoded defaults in logging_config.py and implemented clean Settings-based environment configuration. For Bug #4, the student empirically tested database timezone settings, column types, and redirect queries, proved the reported midnight 404 was unconfirmed, and implemented defensive UTC normalization for naive datetimes. In the BREAK step, the student correctly identified CWE-117 log injection and audit log forgery, implementing multi-layer defense with CRLF escaping, single-line JSON formatting, and schema validation.
